text:
Maya Chen: Quick design check — the error banner on job-run failures currently says: \"Request failed. Try again.\" I feel it's too terse and not helpful for users. Screenshot: https://redwood.prod/snapshots/error-banner-1.png Alex Ortega: Agreed, not great. Users need guidance: is it transient? who to contact? Also worried about line-wrap on mobile. Sam Patel: If we expand it, can we keep a short headline + optional detailed line that wraps under? e.g. headline 1 line, body smaller. Lina Gomez: Copy options from content side — two variants: 1) Short: \"Action failed. Retry or contact support.\" 2) Long: \"We couldn't process your request right now. Try again, or get help via Support (link).\" Which tone do we want? short is more scannable, long is clearer. Priya Rao: Accessibility nits: if we change copy, we should ensure the banner is announced by screen readers. Use `role=alert` or `aria-live=polite` depending on severity. Also color contrast for the red banner is borderline on the current palette. Maya Chen: Good call — I prefer the short headline + smaller body. Proposal: `Error: Action failed.` (headline) `We couldn't process your request. Retry or contact Support.` (body, support is a link) Jordan Lee: I like the structure. Two UX points: 1) include a primary CTA button labeled \"Retry\" so users have a clear affordance; 2) add a tertiary \"Contact support\" link for escalation. For small widths make the CTA icon-only? not sure. Sam Patel: Implementation note — if we add an interactive Retry button we need to manage focus and show inline loading state. Also prefer the button text `Try again` vs `Retry`? `Try again` feels friendlier. Lina Gomez: Leaning `Try again`. Updated copy: Headline: `Error — action failed` Body: `We couldn't process your request. Try again, or contact support.` Button: `Try again` (primary) Link: `Contact support` (text) Priya Rao: One more a11y detail: If the banner appears after a user action (form submit), move focus to the banner region or set `aria-live=\"assertive\"` for immediate announcement. For non-blocking warnings use `aria-live=\"polite\"`. Also ensure `role=\"alertdialog\"` only if it requires user input. Alex Ortega: Mobile wrapping: Maya can you mock 320px width to confirm line breaks? If the CTA is present it should stack below copy on narrow widths. Maya Chen: Will create a quick mock and post. Also adding a contra-variant for very short networks: remove body, just `Error: Try again` when banner is in compact mode. Sam Patel: Fine. For code, suggest the aria snippet: ```html
\n
Error — action failed
\n
We couldn't process your request. Contact support
\n \n
\n``` Lina Gomez: Tone approved. Jordan — are you ok with the `Error — action failed` headline vs `We couldn't process your request` as headline? Jordan Lee: Prefer the `Error — action failed` short headline. It's scannable and pairs well with the body. Approving the copy and CTA layout. :+1: Maya Chen: Mock uploaded: https://redwood.prod/snapshots/error-banner-2.png — includes stacked CTA for mobile and `aria-live=\"assertive\"` in markup. deploy-bot: A/B flag `error_banner_v2` created and ready for engineers to hook up. Sam Patel: I'll pick this up tomorrow — will implement layout + aria attributes and ping QA for contrast check. Alex Ortega: Thanks all — Lina can you add the final copy into the component doc and I'll update the ticket. Lina Gomez: Done — I've updated the component copy doc and left both Short/Compact copy variants. Link: https://redwood.prod/docs/components/alerts#error-banner Maya Chen: Closing loop — we'll ship with `Try again` button + `Contact support` link and `aria-live=assertive`. If QA flags contrast we'll tweak color tokens. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
